job.job_description:
Roles and Responsibilities :

Design, develop, test, and deploy AI models using Python programming language to solve complex business problems.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify areas where AI can add value and implement solutions that drive business outcomes.
Develop data pipelines using AWS services such as S3, Lambda, Step Functions to collect, process, and analyze large datasets.
Troubleshoot issues related to AI model performance, data quality, and system reliability.

Job Requirements :

7-10 years of experience in developing AI models using Python programming language.
Strong understanding of machine learning algorithms and their applications in various industries.
Proficiency in working with big data technologies such as Hadoop ecosystem (HDFS), Spark (Scala/Python), Kafka.
